visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a green shirt and a black baseball cap stands next to a woman with long black hair in a black sleeveless top at a harbor during sunset. The man is gesturing with his hands while speaking to the camera. Behind them, several fishing boats are docked in the calm water. (2) The scene shifts to the man on a fishing boat at sea. He is looking intently at a specialized torch. Suddenly, a large, bright burst of fire erupts from the torch, illuminating the man's face and the deck. The woman stands behind him, her eyes wide with shock and surprise. (3) Night has fallen, and the man and woman are now wearing blue crew shirts. The man has switched to a white cap. They are standing on the deck of the boat, talking animatedly. The background shows the dark sea and distant city lights. (4) A wide shot shows the boat at night. A huge plume of fire is ignited from the bow, casting a brilliant orange glow over the water and the people on board. Camera operators are visible filming the event. (5) The final segment shows the man and woman back on the deck at night, laughing and talking. On-screen text appears announcing the show's premiere details.

(7) [Subtitle]: 所以會有一個蹦的聲音. (8) [Subtitle]: 才曾叫蹦火仔. (9) [Subtitle]: 是那個火蹦的. (10) [Subtitle]: 今天都交給妳!!. (11) [Subtitle]: 你不想臉黑對不對. (12) [Subtitle]: 沒有啦... (13) [Subtitle]: 我是想說妳表現得很好啊. (14) [Subtitle]: 她這麼靠賽你要... (15) [Variety]: 笑鼠直接被嫌棄. (16) [Subtitle]: 拜託拜託拜託拜託. (17) [Subtitle]: 不錯不錯不錯. 就是這種感覺. (18) [Slogan]: 一日漁夫2 金山蹦火仔 ft. 林真亦 8/14 21:30 木曜4超玩 YouTube首播.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Energetic male voice introduces the 'Fire Fishing Boat' over a fast-tempo, upbeat electronic background track. (2) A sharp, explosive 'boom' sound effect marks the ignition of a flare on screen, followed by high-pitched feminine gasps of surprise and male laughter. (3) Rapid conversational exchange between the male and female speakers explaining the name and nature of the fishing technique. The BGM remains steady with a driving beat. (4) Several 'whoosh' and 'pop' transition sound effects occur as visual shots cut rapidly between sunset and nighttime action. (5) Final promotional voice-over details the broadcast time with enthusiastic vocal inflection and a crescendo in the background music.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote an upcoming episode of the popular Taiwanese variety show 'Muyao 4 Super Play,' featuring the hosts experiencing a traditional and rare fishing method called 'Sulfur Fire Fishing' (Bong-ho-ah) in Jinshan.
